IRs make a big difference, using JBL E-120 IRs, this one works well too: https://jerrytonestore.com/store/p/waldotronics-jbl-e120-ir-free-download. author: davidtaus
description: Inspired by Trey's switch to a Dumble Amp. This has all my favorite Trey rig settings over the years.  Snapshots 1-3 control Whammy  settings (down whole step, Octave, "whale") and Snapshot 4 is Leslie.EXP 1 = delay mix. EXP 2 = Dedicated Wah, heel down - off. EXP 3 = volume pedal. Using Celestion G12-65 IRs but Helix 1x12 Creamback or C12N cabs work well. Using a Morningstar MC8 Pro for additional controls, including Whammy, Looper, Mu-Tron (up and down), and Amp OD channel, boost, and bright.

author: benadrian
description:
I wrote this patch to be able to play this song live.
https://gvsg.bandcamp.com/track/relief
There is a dual path in the preset. Path A has a plate reverb for the more straightforward guitar sound. Path B has a Delay, Octoverb, and Particle Verb in series to create a washed out ambient background sound. 
EXP1 controls the feedback of the delay.
EXP2 is volume.
EXP3 is looper level.
Tone was written with a Fender Baja Telecaster, not humbuckers.

This preset uses a JTM 45 amp with a Supro pre-amp and dual cabs. (Jimi Hendrix was known to use both a JTM 45 & a Supro). I lowered the input impedance and did my best to simulate the overly compressed fuzzy low end without too much gain saturation.

This preset is fully loaded out on DSP with 8 different gain stage possibilities, multiple vibe rotary/univibe effects, blended reverbs, and EQ.

I built this patch using the single coil neck pickup on a Telecaster.

Hope you like it!

description:

name: Rockman Edge
author: LonnieWest
description:
This is a recreation of the EDGE tone from the Rockman X100 headphone amp. The tone was created by reverse engineering the X100 schematics and using guidance from Tom Scholz's US Patent 4,584,700 to determine the exact EQ and gain staging used. From this I created custom IR's that have the same EQ curves as the original X100.

Demo tones can be found here: https://youtu.be/Jqg62Afb9To

Impulse Responses can be downloaded here: https://agingengineer.com/download/rockman-x100-impulse-responses/

description:
Template for controlling the YouTube Music with the Helix Floor (just like the YouTube Remote template).

1. Open audio file in YouTube Music 
2. Ensure YouTube Music is the active/focused program
3. Open YT Music Remote template
4. Press the MODE footswitch

Footswitch Assignment: 

FS 1 = BANK ↑
FS 2 = TOGL FULL SCREEN
FS 3 = MUTE ON/OFF
FS 4 = PREVIOUS SONG
FS 5 = NEXT SONG
FS 6 = MODE
FS 7 = BANK ↓
FS 8 = -10 SECONDS
FS 9 = +10 SECONDS
FS 10 = REPLAY MODE
FS 11 = PLAY / PAUSE
FS 12 = TAP

description: Riffing on daddydoodles excellent WorshipGoTo to make it work well with my Shuriken 250 Variax. Separate paths for Variax and mag pups. A separate path is set for USB 3-4 in for synth sounds triggered by a Fishman TriplePlay. Delete that if you don't go there.

description: This is a variax Telecaster model through vdi into Helix LT. Built around Matchstick Jump, this sounds great in a band setting, and covers a lot of sounds from cleanish rhythms, overdriven rock tones and soaring leads to ambient soundscapes and classic U2 rhythm style guitar delay.

author: ddmiller
description: Riffing on the awesome SuproZ preset by the amazing crxshdxmmy... making it work for me and my Shuriken 250. The reverb decays are all controlled from 0 to 100 by Exp1. Volume by Exp2 (mine is external) Each SS switches to a different guitar model on the Variax. All SS's leveled to around -12db.

name: VX StoneSoup
author: ddmiller
description: Made for my Shuriken 250 Variax. Two separate paths for Variax and Mag pups. Stone Age 185 and Soup Pro. 8 snapshots. Clean, Dirty, Grimy and Filthy. 4 more the same with added mod, delay and verb. Use the Exp1 to control depth. Exp2 (external) for vol. I have Clean set to combine Variax acoustic with Mag pups.

name: VX Setzer'ish ^
author: ddmiller
description:
So when you have the best, you can only make it better, right?!

Once again I've taken the great preset from Mr. Sadites and added a second duplicate amp row for mag pups, added a bit of gain for when you wanna rock, and since my Shuriken 250 doesn't have a whammy, a bit of that too! Use Exp1 for that. I have a second exp I use for volume. 8 Snaps!

name: VX Royalty Sky
author: ddmiller
description: Requires 3.0! Using the US Princess amp/cab and the Heir Apparent, hence the "royalty". 8 snaps, stomps for all the FX. As usual, set up for me and my Shuriken 250 Variax. Stereo. All snaps balanced to around -18db.The Exp1 is set to control the mix on the reverbs and delays so keep the heel down unless you want that huge big room sound. I use an external Exp2 for volume.

name: VX RivetRevv Sky

description: Latest in my "Sky" series of presets. This time with dual Revv Gen Purples and dual Jazz Rivets. Set up for me and my Shuriken 250 Variax. 8 snaps. Stomps for all fx. All snaps leveled out to right around -18db, more or less. Change the input blocks if you don't have a Variax. I use an external Exp2 for volume. Exp1 is set to control delay and reverb mix so keep the heel down to start off, and ramp it up for massive swells.

One each for Variax pups and mag pup. Stomps thrown in for those who swing THAT way. I use the Exp1 to control the depth of the "sky". I have an external Exp2 for volume. Enjoy!

PitchWham is always on because I hate the EXP1 toe switch, so keep the EXP1 heel down. I use an external EXP2 for volume. If you don't have a Shuriken, just change the input blocks to what you do have.

name: VX NotTotoNoMore

The delay and reverb depth controlled by Exp1. I use an external Exp2 for volume. 4 gain stages: Clean, Dirty, Grimy and Filthy. What? You say you don't got no steenkin Variax!? Just change the input blocks to what ever your Axe type is.

So to start, keep the Exp1 heel down. I use an external Exp2 for Volume blocks. I've added Stomps for all FX blocks. 4 Snaps for different gain levels.

description: Thank you Line 6 guys. At last, a dual harmoniser/pitch shifter that's as simple to use as my old Yamaha SPX90. Lots of guitarists use this type of effect but Tony Duhig (RIP) of the band Jade Warrior was a real master of using this sort of harmonized tone. Check out the four Island label albums. Floating World (1974) Waves (1975) Kites (1976) Way Of The Sun (1978)

The tone was created by reverse engineering the X100 schematics and using guidance from Tom Scholz's US Patent 4,584,700 to determine the exact EQ and gain staging used. From this I created custom IR's that have the same EQ curves as the original X100.
